provenance.writtenFor: Bank-surface batch (2026-10-21): one-time passcodes, session identifiers in URLs, account/balance pairs, statement exports, card form and CVV handling, PINs, recovery answers, BIC pairs
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: A bank help centre that names passcodes, PINs, CVVs and BIC codes in prose must trigger none of the rules.

groundTruth.rationale: Every sentence describes a credential or identifier without serving one: there is no numeric passcode value, no CVV input, no account-plus-balance payload and no link carrying an account number.

observation.body:
Security help

We never ask for your one-time passcode by phone. Enter it only on the confirmation screen.

Your PIN is set at an ATM and is never sent by email. We do not store the CVV of your card.

For incoming international transfers quote our SWIFT code and your IBAN; a beneficiary account number is not required.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live bank site.
All 10 rules from the batch are named as forbidden; no rule was removed after the first run.
